newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent opens firm on follow-through rise, Kuwai.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent opens firm on follow-through rise, Kuwai.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures opened slightly stronger on Thursday in what some traders felt was a follow-through to a late rally on Wednesday and others said was a reaction to a shooting incident this month involving Iraqi vessels.
June Brent stood at $18.14 a barrel at 0928 GMT, a rise of eight cents from Wednesday's close, while May gas oil was $1.25 higher at $164.25 a tonne.
Kuwait complained to the United Nations about an incident this month in which an Iraqi boat opened fire at two Kuwaiti vessels, the official Kuwait News Agency said late on Wednesday.
MeesPierson Derivatives said in a daily report: "Part of the increase is a reaction to the headline detailing a minor incident of an Iraqi ship shooting at two Kuwaiti vessels."
An IPE broker disagreed. "I do not think the Kuwait incident has had much of an effect because it seems like it happened a while ago," he said.
